summary: A long-running, open-air Northern Thai restaurant on Mahidol Road in Pa Daet, south of central Chiang Mai. Michelin highlights its Lanna cooking with local herbs and wild greens, generous portions, seasonal specials and lap pla phia (Northern-style fish larb). It suits a meal stop near the airport more than an Old City walk-in.
whyGo: Sample a wide Northern Thai menu beyond khao soi, including hang lay curry, local vegetable dishes, nam prik and regional larb.
Michelin describes the cooking as made to order and calls lap pla phia a standout; check for seasonal dishes on arrival.
The Wongnai menu currently lists many shareable dishes at ฿100–219, making it straightforward to build a mixed meal.
bestFor: Groups who want to share several regional dishes in a relaxed, open-air setting.
Visitors travelling along Mahidol Road or seeking a local-style meal near Chiang Mai Airport.
skipIf: You need verified step-free access, an accessible toilet, or controlled indoor seating; these details are not published.
You need a reliably vegetarian, vegan, halal or allergen-controlled menu; ingredients and cross-contact practices are not documented.
duration: Allow about 60–90 minutes for a meal (planning estimate); food is cooked to order and busy periods may take longer.
cost: Michelin lists the restaurant at ฿. Wongnai's current menu shows examples such as hang lay curry ฿150, lap pla phia ฿120, Doi Ngam appetizer platter ฿219, jackfruit salad ฿100 and sticky rice ฿20. Budget around ฿150–350 per person for a shared meal (planning estimate; drinks and dish choices vary).
hours: MICHELIN Guide currently lists every day 10:30–21:30. Wongnai's delivery page reflects different hours, so call +66 53 204 517 before setting out and confirm the December schedule.
bestTime: Go for an early lunch or early dinner to give yourself a better chance of an unhurried meal and seasonal-dish availability. December is a popular travel month; allow extra time for road traffic and confirm holiday service directly.
gettingThere: At 267/1 Mu 2, Mahidol Road, Pa Daet, Chiang Mai 50100. It is a roadside destination outside the Old City; use a taxi or ride-hail and enter the full restaurant name and address in Maps. Allow roughly 10–20 minutes from the Old City by car as a planning estimate, traffic dependent. No dependable direct public-transport route was verified; arrange the return ride before dining if needed.
booking: MICHELIN Guide says the restaurant manages bookings directly and lists +66 53 204 517. Call to reserve for a group and confirm opening, seasonal dishes and holiday hours; no online reservation channel was verified.
accessibility: Michelin describes an open-air restaurant but does not document step-free access, wheelchair routes, accessible toilets or seating support. Ask the restaurant about entrance steps, table access and toilets before travelling if these matter.
practicalTips: Order a few dishes to share; the menu includes hang lay, local greens, northern dips, larb, grilled/steamed dishes and sticky rice.
Confirm the specific branch: same-name restaurants have operated on opposite sides of Mahidol Road; Michelin's 267/1 address is the Krua Mueang Classic listing.
Ask about spice, fish/meat ingredients and allergens directly. The listed specialties include fish, pork and fermented or chilli-based preparations.
Secure a ride back before you sit down; a convenient public-transport connection was not confirmed.
decemberNotes: The researched hours and menu are current listings as of 2026-10-17, not a published December 2026 holiday schedule. Call shortly before visiting, especially around Christmas and New Year, to confirm opening and availability of seasonal dishes.
uncertainties: December 2026 opening hours, holiday closures and menu availability are unannounced.
Wongnai delivery hours differ from Michelin's dine-in listing; direct confirmation is advisable.
Prices are current online menu examples and may change before the trip; per-person budget is an estimate.
Vegetarian/vegan, halal, allergen and cross-contact accommodations are unverified.
Step-free access, accessible toilets, parking details and reliable public transport were not verified.
